commands.name: view
commands.summary: render a frame or a contact sheet of a project
usage: [--from t --until t --count n] [--cols n] [--asset <id>] [--max-tokens n] [--width px]

flags.name: mode
flags.usage: frame (one image at --at) or sheet (a grid)

flags.name: at
flags.usage: frame: the time to show

flags.name: times
flags.usage: sheet: 2 to 16 times, comma separated

flags.name: from
flags.usage: sheet: first time (default 0s)

flags.name: until
flags.usage: sheet: last time, included (default the last frame)

flags.name: count
flags.usage: sheet: frames evenly spaced from --from to --until

flags.name: cols
flags.usage: sheet: columns (default ceil(sqrt(count)))

flags.name: asset
flags.usage: view the media of a source asset instead of the timeline

flags.name: max-tokens
flags.usage: image token budget (default 800, a sheet 1,500; at most 1,568)

flags.name: width
flags.usage: image width in pixels, even; exclusive with --max-tokens
